outgoingFlows.description: Progression from symptom onset to death, governed by the onset-to-death distribution, scaled by the infection fatality ratio

parameters.name: R0
parameters.description: Initial reproduction number before interventions, averaged across all 11 countries (95% CI: 2.4–5.6)

parameters.name: Rt
parameters.description: Average time-varying reproduction number across 11 countries after interventions

parameters.name: ifr
parameters.description: Population-averaged infection fatality ratio, adjusted for age structure and contact patterns of each country

parameters.name: infection_to_onset
parameters.description: Mean time from infection to onset of symptoms (incubation period), used in the infection-to-death distribution

parameters.name: onset_to_death
parameters.description: Mean time from onset of symptoms to death, used in the infection-to-death distribution

parameters.name: generation_interval
parameters.description: Mean generation time (serial interval distribution used as approximation), representing average time from infection of one person to infection of another

parameters.name: lockdown_effect
parameters.description: Estimated relative reduction in Rt due to lockdown intervention (95% CI: 75–87%)

parameters.name: alpha_lockdown
parameters.description: Country-specific effect of lockdown via partial pooling

parameters.name: alpha_school_closure
parameters.description: Shared effect size parameter for school closure intervention across countries

parameters.name: alpha_public_events
parameters.description: Shared effect size parameter for banning public events across countries

parameters.name: alpha_self_isolation
parameters.description: Shared effect size parameter for case-based self-isolation measures across countries

parameters.name: alpha_social_distancing
parameters.description: Shared effect size parameter for social distancing encouraged across countries
